description: Source code for ServerProcess class that manages subprocesses with request/response model, including process control, I/O handling, and platform-specific APIs.

classes.name: ServerProcess
classes.description: A wrapper class for managing subprocesses with request/response communication, process control, and platform-specific I/O handling.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes ServerProcess with process parameters and platform-specific settings.

methods.name: name
methods.description: Returns the process name.

methods.name: pid
methods.description: Returns the process ID.

methods.name: _reset
methods.description: Resets internal process state and buffers.

methods.name: _start
methods.description: Starts the subprocess with specified command and environment.

methods.name: _handle_possible_interrupt
methods.description: Checks if process exited due to interrupt and raises KeyboardInterrupt.

methods.name: poll
methods.description: Checks if the process is still running.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Sends data to the subprocess stdin.

methods.name: _pop_stdout_line_if_ready
methods.description: Retrieves a complete stdout line if available.

methods.name: _pop_stderr_line_if_ready
methods.description: Retrieves a complete stderr line if available.

methods.name: pop_all_buffered_stderr
methods.description: Returns all buffered stderr data.

methods.name: read_stdout_line
methods.description: Reads a line from stdout with deadline.

methods.name: read_stderr_line
methods.description: Reads a line from stderr with deadline.

methods.name: read_either_stdout_or_stderr_line
methods.description: Reads from either stdout or stderr with deadline.

methods.name: read_stdout
methods.description: Reads specified amount of data from stdout with deadline.

methods.name: _log
methods.description: Logs a message.

methods.name: _log_data
methods.description: Logs data lines with prefix.

methods.name: _handle_timeout
methods.description: Handles process timeout.

methods.name: _split_string_after_index
methods.description: Splits string at given index.

methods.name: _pop_output_bytes
methods.description: Extracts bytes from output buffer.

methods.name: _pop_error_bytes
methods.description: Extracts bytes from error buffer.

methods.name: _wait_for_data_and_update_buffers_using_select
methods.description: Uses select() to wait for process output and update buffers.

methods.name: _wait_for_data_and_update_buffers_using_win32_apis
methods.description: Uses Win32 APIs to wait for process output on Windows.

methods.name: _non_blocking_read_win32
methods.description: Performs non-blocking read from Win32 handle.

methods.name: has_crashed
methods.description: Checks if process has crashed or exited unexpectedly.

methods.name: _read
methods.description: Core read loop handling deadlines and process crash detection.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the process if not already running.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the process, optionally with timeout, and returns remaining output/error.

methods.name: _kill
methods.description: Kills the process.

methods.name: replace_input
methods.description: Replaces process stdin.

methods.name: replace_outputs
methods.description: Replaces process stdout and stderr.
